answer: Random peer audit keeps the garden of identities honest. Each new identity plants a lotus stake of 200 credits, locked for 20 epochs. A random beacon picks three peers to audit its work; any delta between claimed and verified output triggers a check. If the audit exposes a clone, the stake burns and its cluster is marked. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 200 = 20,000 credits, all lost, while one honest lotus pays once and keeps rewards undiluted.
